summary: @dataclass writes __init__, __repr__, and __eq__ for a class from its field list. @dataclass(frozen=True) makes objects that cannot change after creation.
notes: Each field needs a type hint, such as score: int. Fields without a hint are not part of the dataclass.
__post_init__ runs right after the generated __init__, so it is the place to validate values.
field(default_factory=list) gives each object its own new list.
pitfall: Writing tags: list[str] = [] raises ValueError: mutable default <class 'list'> for field tags is not allowed: use default_factory.
